label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen06Subtitle
text: *We have acquired GPS Scramble technology! Now we can use Kassad's tricks against him!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen07Subtitle
text: *Excellent, General! We have secured the Sneak Attack ability!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen08Subtitle
text: *Capture the enemy Command Centers

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen09Subtitle
text: *If we can capture the enemy Command Center we can use their technology against them

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen10Subtitle
text: *General, we must capture their Command Center and use their knowledge to progress towards our goal of uniting the GLA under one flag

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen11Subtitle
text: *We are running low on resources. We must capture some oil derricks

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen12Subtitle
text: *Our enemy is attacking our Oil Supply! They must be stopped!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen13Subtitle
text: *Use the GPS scramble to sneak past the enemy defenses!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen14Subtitle
text: *The GPS Scramble will not work here, there are too many Stinger Sites.We will need to use a different tactic

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen15Subtitle
text: *Perhaps we can find an unguarded area to use our new Sneak Attack ability

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen16Subtitle
text: *Do not destroy the Command Center. We need to capture the structure and keep it intact

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen17Subtitle
text: *Their knowledge must be stolen. We need to use their advanced tactics to defeat them!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen18Subtitle
text: *General, be wary of snipers -- Kassad loves to use them

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen19Subtitle
text: *This bridge is heavily defended. We will need assistance in getting across it

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen20Subtitle
text: *Capture the enemy Command Center to the North!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen21Subtitle
text: *Capture the enemy Command Center to the West!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen22Subtitle
text: *General, if we capture this cannon, we can use it against Kassad's forces!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen23Subtitle
text: *If we capture the Command Center, we can use their abilities to turn the tide of this battle

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen24Subtitle
text: *Prince Kassad is no more. The GLA are once again united against our enemies!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen25Subtitle
text: *Now that we have GPS scramble, we can move unseen past Kassad's bridge defenses!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen26Subtitle
text: *The traitor has fortified himself on this hilltop and cut all other means of access. Sneak Attack is the only way we have to strike at his main base

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen27Subtitle
text: *General, this area is being controlled by Prince Kassad. He has turned his back on his brethren and will not aid us in our cause against the infidels

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen28Subtitle
text: *Kassad is a master of stealth, hiding his forces in plain sight. He refuses to share his knowledge with us, so we will take it from him

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen29Subtitle
text: *A GLA splinter cell commanded by Prince Kassad is controlling this area. Kassad refuses to let us use his abilities for the good of the GLA

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen30Subtitle
text: *Kassad is a master of stealth, relying on several techniques to surprise and attack his enemies

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen31Subtitle
text: *GPS scramble gives him the power to have any unit strike unseen against an enemy

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen32Subtitle
text: *Tunnel sneak attacks offer further tactical advantages

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen33Subtitle
text: *We must have these technologies. If Kassad will not share, we will take them from him. Capture his command centers and turn his own abilities against him!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03Kenwar03Subtitle
text: *Free our imprisoned brothers

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03Kenwar15Subtitle
text: *We have spotted a Prison Camp, our brothers are held inside

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xBrf01Subtitle
text: *Welcome, Commander!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xBrf02Subtitle
text: *Kassad was too cowardly to make an attempt against the US such as this. General, you are truly a master mind

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xBrf03Subtitle
text: *Once the US Mediterranean naval force is shattered all of Europe will be in our grasp

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xBrf04Subtitle
text: *Now that we are again united, it is time to make our strength felt!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xBrf05Subtitle
text: *The USA has attacked our secret base in the Mediterranean

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xBrf06Subtitle
text: *But before it was wiped out, we learned of the location of their Particle Cannon and naval fleet in the region

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xBrf07Subtitle
text: *Most of their ships are in port and helpless. We will steal their Particle Cannon and use it to take out their Aircraft Carrier!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xBrf08Subtitle
text: *Look for an opportunity to reclaim and rebuild our secret base

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xChat01Subtitle
text: *We'll die for you!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xChat02Subtitle
text: *Another one bites the dust

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xChat03Subtitle
text: *More victims for me

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xChat04Subtitle
text: *Mow them down!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xChat05Subtitle
text: *They cannot escape our wrath!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xChat06Subtitle
text: *We have them where we want them!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xChat07Subtitle
text: *Victory will be ours!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xChat08Subtitle
text: *That made a big splash!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xCin01Subtitle
text: *We will avenge this cowardly attack!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xCin02Subtitle
text: *Their carrier will be turned into scrap!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xCin03Subtitle
text: *We have proven the might of the GLA!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen01Subtitle
text: *Our Hijackers could take that tank easily

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen02Subtitle
text: *That Ranger is running for help! We must not let him get away

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen03Subtitle
text: *We'll need this Particle Cannon to sink the enemy Carrier. Defend it well!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen04Subtitle
text: *Our rebels can use their Capture Building ability to take control of the Particle Cannon

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen05Subtitle
text: *We can use our Sneak Attack to create Tunnel Networks on nearby islands

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen06Subtitle
text: *We must not let the pilot reach his Tomahawk!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen07Subtitle
text: *They're coming after the Tomahawk!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen08Subtitle
text: *This Barracks is now ours

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen09Subtitle
text: *We have liberated this Palace

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen10Subtitle
text: *This Arms Dealer will serve us well

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen11Subtitle
text: *We have reclaimed our Command Center!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen12Subtitle
text: *General, do you see those enemy supply planes? If we could destroy their drop zones, we would cripple their production!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen13Subtitle
text: *Ah, this toxic tractor will come in handy

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen14Subtitle
text: *These Quad Cannons will defend us from enemy aircraft

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen15Subtitle
text: *These Marauders will boost our firepower

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen16Subtitle
text: *Destroy these tanks and we can liberate the Barracks!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen17Subtitle
text: *If we clear this area, we can safely occupy the Command Center

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen18Subtitle
text: *Kill those troops and the Arms Dealer will be ours!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen19Subtitle
text: *They may be launching an attack against us! Defend our buildings!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen20Subtitle
text: *Comanches! Rally our air defenses!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen21Subtitle
text: *We must defend against those Comanches!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen22Subtitle
text: *They are trying to retake the Particle Cannon!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen23Subtitle
text: *Their aircraft have destroyed our Tunnel Network!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen24Subtitle
text: *Those clever villains! They are targeting our Power Plants. We need power to use the Particle Cannon

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen25Subtitle
text: *Almost all of the power plants have been destroyed. We must have power to use the Particle Cannon!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen26Subtitle
text: *If we could capture some power plants, we could use the Particle Cannon against them

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen27Subtitle
text: *Ahh.. We have found some hidden goodies

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen28Subtitle
text: *This pass is well defended. We should use the Particle Cannon to blast through

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen29Subtitle
text: *Be careful! This pass is heavily guarded!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen30Subtitle
text: *They've dispatched infantry onto the islands!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen31Subtitle
text: *They're choppers are bringing reinforcements!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen32Subtitle
text: *They have launched an A10 Strike against us!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen33Subtitle
text: *They've paradropped onto the Particle Cannon!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen34Subtitle
text: *We have disabled their Supply Drop Zones! Their production will be crippled!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen35Subtitle
text: *Your mission is to destroy the enemy Aircraft Carrier with the Particle Cannon. You will have to penetrate their base on the mainland to get a visual lock on the Carrier so that you can destroy it

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen36Subtitle
text: *Great work! Now we must secure some Power Plants

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen37Subtitle
text: *The Tunnel Network will bring us to the next island

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen38Subtitle
text: *The Particle Cannon is now online. We should defend it and the Power Plants

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen39Subtitle
text: *All of our units and buildings have been destroyed!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen40Subtitle
text: *Without the Particle Cannon, it will be impossible to sink the Carrier

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen41Subtitle
text: *Now the Americans shall taste bitter defeat!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen42Subtitle
text: *They destroyed our Tunnel Network! Use the sneak attack to reclaim the Particle Cannon!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen43Subtitle
text: *We are closing in on the Aircraft Carrier. It is just south of here

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen44Subtitle
text: *There's the Aircraft Carrier! Destroy it using the Particle Cannon!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen45Subtitle
text: *Jarmen Kell is here to serve us

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen46Subtitle
text: *His snipe ability can disable enemy vehicles, allowing our infantry to then capture them

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen47Subtitle
text: *These docked Battleships are harmless

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen48Subtitle
text: *The Battleship is bombarding us! Destroy it!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen49Subtitle
text: *This must be the enemy's main base

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen50Subtitle
text: *These fake buildings will fool our foes

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA03xKen51Subtitle
text: *Build more fake structures to trick the enemy!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04Dispatcher06Subtitle
text: *American forces are on their way

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xChat01Subtitle
text: *We've got to clear out those bunkers!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xChat02Subtitle
text: *Their power is down! No Patriots to deal with!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xChat03Subtitle
text: *Break down the fences and rescue our brethren!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xChat04Subtitle
text: *Now our brothers may be free!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xChat05Subtitle
text: *An american chinook would help to transport our troops. Capture this supply depot if you can

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xChat06Subtitle
text: *Get some anti air over here, general! Their Comanches are tearing us to bits!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xChat07Subtitle
text: *General, we must find some way to take out these bridge defenses!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xChat08Subtitle
text: *General, we are using our cell phones to call in a surprise tunnel network!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xChat09Subtitle
text: *We'll need these tractors if we want to clear any bunkers

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xChat10Subtitle
text: *This ferry is under our control now! You will take us where we want to go!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xChat11Subtitle
text: *Yes, yes. I will do what you say!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xChat12Subtitle
text: *Our brothers have been freed

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xChat13Subtitle
text: *There sure are a lot of sports utility vehicles in this strange land

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xChat14Subtitle
text: *We have a GLA sympathizer in this area. He and his brothers have agreed to help us

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xChat15Subtitle
text: *Tanks! Take off! Go, Go, Go!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin01Subtitle
text: *This is team one. We are in position

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin02Subtitle
text: *My brethren, be careful, as we tread on enemy soil. Our main objective is to obtain chemical samples from the nearby American toxin facility

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin03Subtitle
text: *The remains of the American naval force have moved to the Mediterranean, in response to the loss of their command fleet. This has allowed us to slip in

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin04Subtitle
text: *We defeated them there, and we shall be victorious here

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin05Subtitle
text: *Brothers rejoice! Once we have the toxins from this facility, our scientists will be able to forge a weapon of mass infection

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin06Subtitle
text: *The Americans have meddled for too long. With this new weapon, we shall be able to strike fear into the hearts of our oppressors!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin07Subtitle
text: *(Very evil laugh)

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin08Subtitle
text: *Team one, are toxins secured and on board?

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin09Subtitle
text: *We have the samples

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin10Subtitle
text: *We are ready for takeoff

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin11Subtitle
text: *Check. Package is secure

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin12Subtitle
text: *You are clear to proceed. We will defend your escape!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin13Subtitle
text: *General the Patriots are online!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin14Subtitle
text: *Hold them back until we clear the landing strip!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin15Subtitle
text: *Keep them off our tail!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin16Subtitle
text: *Get away you stupid Americans!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin17Subtitle
text: *We'll meet again when we reach the toxin facility

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin18Subtitle
text: *The Americans think they have driven us out

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin19Subtitle
text: *We will divide and conquer

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin20Subtitle
text: *We are nothing against this air power!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin21Subtitle
text: *You have not seen the last of us!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin22Subtitle
text: *We will get our revenge, you filthy Americans!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin23Subtitle
text: *Let's do our part to take down these capitalist pigs!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin24Subtitle
text: *These Americans will pay for the lives of our brethren

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin25Subtitle
text: *Let's light up these GLA intruders! Fox 1!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin26Subtitle
text: *GLA spotted offshore! All units to defense positions

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin27Subtitle
text: *We got GLA infiltration at coordinated 77BetaGamma! All available units move to respond!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin28Subtitle
text: *There's more of them on the beach!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin29Subtitle
text: *GLA infiltrators spotted on the ledge!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xCin30Subtitle
text: *We've got GLA inside city limits! All units converge on coordinates 34AlphaAlpha

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen01Subtitle
text: *Good job, General! Only 15 more toxin samples to be retrieved

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen02Subtitle
text: *Good job, General! Only 10 more toxin samples to be retrieved

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen03Subtitle
text: *Good job, General! Only 5 more toxin samples to be retrieved

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen04Subtitle
text: *General, we have a plan to attack America's Central Command in Europe. But we do not yet have the power to strike at them directly. We need a new toxin weapon

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen05Subtitle
text: *Both of our forces are in place. The two groups must work together if we are to retrieve the toxins

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen06Subtitle
text: *Our hijackers can capture vehicles and they are stealthed unless they are moving

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen07Subtitle
text: *Jarmen Kell can snipe pilots from vehicles and also take out infantry at long range

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen08Subtitle
text: *Our Saboteurs can perform a number of secret operations like shutting down power plants

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen09Subtitle
text: *Our rebels are camouflaged, and can capture buildings to aid us in our cause

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen10Subtitle
text: *Good luck, General. May stealth and cunning be with you in your quest

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen11Subtitle
text: *Good morning, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen12Subtitle
text: *General, we must capture that ferry

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen13Subtitle
text: *General, there are mines here, but we cannot detect them! We need a Radar Van!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen14Subtitle
text: *General, get someone into that Valve station by the river. Draining the coolant reservoir will allow our brothers to continue further

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen15Subtitle
text: *Excellent

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen16Subtitle
text: *Good work

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen17Subtitle
text: *General! Destroy that airfield before we are wiped out!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen18Subtitle
text: *General. We must destroy their power! Then the Americans will be sitting ducks for sure!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen19Subtitle
text: *General, we must capture that toxin facility

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen20Subtitle
text: *Excellent work, General. Now we must protect these trucks as they transport the toxins to the cargo plane

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen21Subtitle
text: *Use the trucks to begin gathering toxins from the facility

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen22Subtitle
text: *General, the Americans have sent reinforcements!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen23Subtitle
text: *Another cell of hijackers has arrived to support our cause

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen24Subtitle
text: *Another cell of rebels has arrived to support our cause

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen25Subtitle
text: *JarmenKell has been found and he has returned to help our cause

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen26Subtitle
text: *Our brothers have broken through and provided us with reinforcements

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen27Subtitle
text: *The US will not suspect an attack on their soil after our victory in Greece

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen28Subtitle
text: *Kassad would never have had the courage to attack the US homeland

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA04xKen29Subtitle
text: *Once we've stolen the secret toxin agent from the US Bio Center, we will be unstoppable

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05Buggy104Subtitle
text: *Beware Patriot Batteries, they are dangerous

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05Buggy108Subtitle
text: *Go to your graves, American scum!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05Kenwar02bSubtitle
text: *Destroy the American airbase and they will lose much of their ability to project power in this region

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05Kenwar05Subtitle
text: *The Americans will use their airpower to stop us

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05Quad201Subtitle
text: *Die American!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05Rebel02Subtitle
text: *We are defenseless against American air attacks!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05Scorpion105Subtitle
text: *American cowards! Fight on the ground, like men!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xChat01Subtitle
text: *This region is under the control of the United States Air Force General Granger. We can and will use force to remove you from this area. You are hereby under order to clear out immediately

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xCin01Subtitle
text: *Our forces are few, but we can use what we have to come out on top

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xCin02Subtitle
text: *Since we do not have a base in this region we must take one!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xCin03Subtitle
text: *The Chinese base We must strike now! Their Base will soon be ours!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xJarmen01Subtitle
text: *If you rescue our fellow comrades from the Southern US base, our elite warriors will fight alongside you!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xJarmen02Subtitle
text: *Thank you for rescuing our brothers! In return we will open up an area of the US base for you to begin your assault

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xJarmen03Subtitle
text: *Heh heh heh heh heh (Sinister Laugh) That will teach them

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xJarmen04Subtitle
text: *Do not let our deaths go unpunished!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xJarmen05Subtitle
text: *Together we have beaten the enemy! Victory is ours!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xJarmen06Subtitle
text: *Thank you for your help in rescuing my soldiers. We shall repay the favor and help you to take out the U.S. Central Command Base

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen01Subtitle
text: *Once this base is destroyed the US will scurry home like cowardly dogs. All of Europe will be ours

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen02Subtitle
text: *The Americans have our brethren held hostage in their base. We must rescue them

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen03Subtitle
text: *It is in our best interest to rescue the POW's from the clutches of the Americans

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen04Subtitle
text: *Good work! Capture or eliminate this base to ensure the POW's safety

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen05Subtitle
text: *We must transport them safely back home to their base in the North. No harm must come to them

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen06Subtitle
text: *We are running low on supplies. We must spread out and capture new resources

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen07Subtitle
text: *More attacks from the air! We must build more air defenses

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA05xKen08Subtitle
text: *Rebuild our defenses quickly, we haven't long before the next attack
